title: The Solar System and space
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: The Solar System is gravitationally bound. Local forces dominate there, so the expansion seen between widely separated galaxies does not simply stretch planetary orbits.

misconception: A learner may choose: Yes: every orbit expands at the cosmic rate
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Does cosmic expansion force the Solar System to expand along with distant intergalactic space?
